title: On Solving the puzzle before supper
subtitle: 科学探索 · 主题语境阅读

intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 solve 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1969 the baker ① solved the puzzle before supper at once, and every customer in the bakery said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three weeks on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the baker ② solves the puzzle before supper in the rain without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ solve the puzzle before supper at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ solved the puzzle before supper before — a line in the bill for December 1963 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Solving the puzzle before supper at once, the baker said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the tray at the far oven, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ solve the riddle in a single line in the rain, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Solve the riddle in a single line at once and never mention it again.

By 1976 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the bill, and a new customer from the next bakery ⑧ solves the riddle in a single line at once every week without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the oven, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ solved the puzzle before supper again when nobody else would.

⑩ To solve the puzzle before supper, my mother said in 1981, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the bakery remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the bakery forgets, somebody solves the puzzle before supper in the rain again and somebody must solve the puzzle before supper at once all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 解决（一般过去式 solved the puzzle before supper：1969 年面点师头一回这样做，二话不说地）
B. v. 解决（一般现在 solves the puzzle before supper：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 解决（不定式 to solve the puzzle before supper：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 解决（过去完成时 had solved the puzzle before supper：1963 年十二月的账单上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 解决（动名词 solving the puzzle before supper 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 解答（solve the riddle in a single line：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去解答一句话就把那个谜底说破）
G. v. 解答（solve the riddle in a single line：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 解决（后段两处：新来的顾客照例 solves the riddle in a single line，而母亲又一次 solved the puzzle before supper）

answers.why: solve 意为“解决”，1969 年面点师二话不说地解决晚饭前就把这个谜解开了，那是糕饼铺里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 solved。
solve 意为“解决”，自那以后面点师淋着雨把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 solves。
solve 意为“解决”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯解决晚饭前就把这个谜解开了”，此处为不定式 to solve the puzzle before supper。
solve 意为“解决”，账单里 十二月 那行字说明早在 1976 年之前就有人解决过，故用过去完成时 had solved。
solve 意为“解决”，面点师说“解决晚饭前就把这个谜解开了这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 solving the puzzle before supper 作主语。
solve 意为“解答”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去解答一句话就把那个谜底说破”，should ever 之后用原形 solve the riddle in a single line。
solve 意为“解答”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻解答一句话就把那个谜底说破（solve the riddle in a single line at once），以后再也不要提起。
solve 意为“解决”，新来的顾客每个星期都照例解答一句话就把那个谜底说破，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 solves。
solve 意为“解决”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次二话不说地解决晚饭前就把这个谜解开了，用一般过去式 solved 叙述。
solve 意为“解决”，结尾那句是母亲 1981 年的话：要解决晚饭前就把这个谜解开了，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和糕饼铺记住的那一件。
